newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firms buy 65,000 T U.S. wheat, seek more.
newsitem.headline: Manila firms buy 65,000 T U.S. wheat, seek more.

text.p: Philippine firms bought a total of 65,000 tonnes U.S. wheat in the past two days after prices dropped due to prospects of better harvests in the United States this year, Manila grains traders said on Friday.
A group of flour millers also sought tenders for the supply of an additional 35,000 tonnes U.S. wheat today, they said.
Traders said the 65,000 tonnes U.S. wheat bought by local millers were in two separate transactions.
The first order involved 24,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat and 16,000 tonnes western white wheat for October shipment bought by a group of millers.
The second order was for the delivery of 19,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content and 6,000 tonnes western white wheat to another mill based in Cebu, traders said.
Traders involved in both deals declined to quote prices at which the wheat were bought.
Another group of millers is also set to open later today tenders for the supply of 29,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content and 6,000 tonnes western white wheat.
"Local flour millers are jumping into the market to take advantage of low prices," a senior trader said.
